_comment: One entry per Formspree survey. scripts/build_formspree_dashboards.py reads the key from the env var named in key_env. labels / questions are optional: any field or answer without one is shown as its form value, humanized. launch_at (ISO time) marks earlier sessions as tests; null means no session is treated as a test unless listed in test_session_ids. kinds (optional) forces a field to "single", "multi", "scale", "number" or "text" when guessing from the answers gets it wrong.
